source.anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Continuous-weight covariation of two completed Itô rows. Exact assumptions and formula below.
source.original_text:
Let X and Y be two real Itô rows driven by the same standard vector Brownian motion relative to the given filtration and measure. For an almost surely continuous real weight with measurable time slices, the left-endpoint weighted products of dyadic increments converge in measure to the time integral of the weight times the inner product of the diffusion coefficients.

The horizon T is positive. The sample measure is finite, and the filtration satisfies the usual conditions. The coordinate set is finite with decidable equality.
Each row uses progressive square-integrable coefficients on the product of the sample measure and the horizon time measure. Its drift has almost-everywhere strongly measurable evaluations up to T and almost surely continuous finite-variation paths on [0,T].
At each fixed t≤T the weight W(t) is almost-everywhere strongly measurable. Almost every weight path is continuous on [0,T].

\sum_i W(t_i)\,(X_{t_{i+1}}-X_{t_i})(Y_{t_{i+1}}-Y_{t_i})\xrightarrow{\mu}\int_{[0,T]} W(s)\sum_j\eta_j(s)\xi_j(s)\,ds.

theorem anonymous_target.{u_1,
    u_2}
  {Ω : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
  {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal inferInstance} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {T : NNReal} {B : NNReal → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ J}
  (hB :
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.BrownianMotion.IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B
      filtration μ)
  (hT : 0 < T)
  (hUsual : AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration μ)
  (η ξ : J → AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T)
  (A C W : NNReal → Ω → ℝ) (hAmeas : ∀ t ≤ T, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (A t) μ)
  (hCmeas : ∀ t ≤ T, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (C t) μ)
  (hWmeas : ∀ t ≤ T, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (W t) μ)
  (hA : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => A t ω) (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧ BoundedVariationOn (fun t => A t ω) (Set.Icc 0 T))
  (hC : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => C t ω) (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧ BoundedVariationOn (fun t => C t ω) (Set.Icc 0 T))
  (hW : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => W t ω) (Set.Icc 0 T)) :
  have X := fun t ω =>
    A t ω +
      ∑ j,
        AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralProcess.itoIntegralProcess (η j) hT ⋯ hUsual t
          ω;
  have Y := fun t ω =>
    C t ω +
      ∑ j,
        AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralProcess.itoIntegralProcess (ξ j) hT ⋯ hUsual t
          ω;
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ
    (fun n ω =>
      have t :=
        AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
          (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T n)
          (2 ^ n);
      ∑ i, W (t i.castSucc) ω * ((X (t i.succ) ω - X (t i.castSucc) ω) * (Y (t i.succ) ω - Y (t i.castSucc) ω)))
    Filter.atTop fun ω =>
    ∫ (s : NNReal),
      W s ω *
        ∑ j,
          (η j).process s ω *
            (ξ j).process s ω ∂AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T

Objects: Write R_+=[0,infinity), and let lambda_T be Lebesgue measure on [0,T], transported to R_+ (the given comap of volume restricted to [0,T]). All time integrals below use this measure unless indicated otherwise. For n in N put t[n,i]=i*T/2^n for i=0,...,2^n, and Delta_i^n Z=Z(t[n,i+1])-Z(t[n,i]). A ProgressiveL2Integrand eta on horizon T is a real process eta(t,omega), strongly progressive for the filtration, with (omega,t) -> eta(t,omega) in L^2(mu x lambda_T). I_T^j(eta) denotes the supplied completed continuous Ito process driven by the scalar coordinate B_j(t,omega)=(B(t,omega))_j: the pointwise limit of chosen elementary stochastic-integral approximations off their null uniform-Cauchy bad set, zero on that bad set, and held constant after T; at each t<=T it agrees almost everywhere with the L^2-completion integral up to t. Set X=A+sum_j I_T^j(eta_j), Y=C+sum_j I_T^j(xi_j). The integrand's toLp operation is its L^2 equivalence class represented by (omega,t)->eta(t,omega).

Domains: Omega measurable; J finite with decidable equality; mu finite; R_+-filtration; T>0; vector B:R_+ x Omega->R^J; eta,xi indexed by J; A,C,W:R_+ x Omega->R.

Quantifiers: Universally all space and measure data, B and hypotheses, eta,xi,A,C,W; slice measurability of A,C,W; path assumptions of A,C,W. Then n->infinity.

Assumptions: The vector Brownian hypothesis means B(0,omega)=0 for every omega; increments on finite families of pairwise disjoint half-open intervals are jointly independent; every continuous real linear functional ell sends B(t)-B(s), s<t, to a centered Gaussian of variance (t-s)||ell||^2; paths are mu-almost surely continuous. B is strongly adapted, and for every s<=t the increment B(t)-B(s) is independent of the sigma-algebra filtration(s). The filtration is right continuous, and every mu-null subset of Omega belongs to filtration(t) for every t>=0 (completeness at each time). eta_j,xi_j are progressive L^2 integrands on T. For each t<=T, the three slices A_t,C_t,W_t are mu-a.e. strongly measurable. A and C have continuous bounded-variation paths on [0,T] almost everywhere (separate statements); W has continuous paths there almost everywhere. No adaptedness or uniform deterministic bound on W is supplied.

Conclusion: The left-weighted sums sum_i W(t[n,i],omega)*Delta_i^n X(omega)*Delta_i^n Y(omega) converge in mu-measure as n->infinity to integral_0^T W(s,omega)*sum_j eta_j(s,omega)*xi_j(s,omega) ds.

Scopes: One terminal horizon T is fixed. Convergence is in measure, not claimed in L^1, almost surely, or uniformly over terminal times. Weights are evaluated at left endpoints; products use full adjacent increments.

Constant dependencies: No quantitative constant is stated; samplewise continuity permits sample-dependent bounds but no deterministic one is hypothesized. All data may influence convergence.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.CountableConvergenceInMeasure
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicWeightedLimits

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoDyadicWeightedCovariation

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped BigOperators NNReal Topology
open BrownianMotion ProgressiveL2 ElementaryItoIntegral SampledElementaryApproximation
  DyadicElementaryRefinement EuclideanBrownianCoordinates ItoIntegralProcess ItoDyadicPrefixQV
  ItoDyadicPrefixCrossQV CountableConvergenceInMeasure DyadicWeightedLimits
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.PrefixIntegral

/-- Continuous left-endpoint weights against the covariation of two actual
completed Itô rows converge to the weighted integral of the diffusion inner product. -/
theorem tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_weighted_covariation_of_ito_rows
    {Ω J : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    {filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω)}
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {T : ℝ≥0}
    {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ J}
    (hB : IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B filtration μ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hUsual : SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration μ)
    (η ξ : J → ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T)
    (A C W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hAmeas : ∀ t ≤ T, AEStronglyMeasurable (A t) μ)
    (hCmeas : ∀ t ≤ T, AEStronglyMeasurable (C t) μ)
    (hWmeas : ∀ t ≤ T, AEStronglyMeasurable (W t) μ)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => A t ω) (Icc 0 T) ∧
      BoundedVariationOn (fun t => A t ω) (Icc 0 T))
    (hC : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => C t ω) (Icc 0 T) ∧
      BoundedVariationOn (fun t => C t ω) (Icc 0 T))
    (hW : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => W t ω) (Icc 0 T)) :
    let X := fun t ω => A t ω + ∑ j : J,
      itoIntegralProcess (η j) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian j) hUsual t ω
    let Y := fun t ω => C t ω + ∑ j : J,
      itoIntegralProcess (ξ j) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian j) hUsual t ω
    TendstoInMeasure μ (fun n ω =>
      let t := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
      ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), W (t i.castSucc) ω *
        ((X (t i.succ) ω - X (t i.castSucc) ω) * (Y (t i.succ) ω - Y (t i.castSucc) ω)))
      atTop (fun ω => ∫ s, W s ω *
        (∑ j : J, (η j).process s ω * (ξ j).process s ω) ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)) := by
  intro X Y
  let t (n : ℕ) := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
  let Δ (F : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) (ω : Ω) :=
    F (t n i.succ) ω - F (t n i.castSucc) ω
  let z (ω : Ω) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) := Δ X n i ω * Δ Y n i ω
  let b (ω : Ω) (s : ℝ≥0) := ∑ j : J, (η j).process s ω * (ξ j).process s ω
  let S (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) := ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), W (t n i.castSucc) ω * z ω n i
  let P (m : ℕ) (k : Fin (2 ^ m + 1)) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :=
    ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), if t n i.succ ≤ t m k then z ω n i else 0
  let Q (F : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :=
    ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), if t n i.succ ≤ t 0 (Fin.last (2 ^ (0 : ℕ))) then Δ F n i ω ^ 2 else 0
  let E (r : J → ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T) (ω : Ω) :=
    ∑ j : J, ∫ s in Iic (t 0 (Fin.last (2 ^ (0 : ℕ)))), (r j).process s ω ^ 2 ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
  have ht (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n + 1)) : t n i ≤ T :=
    ((regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT n) _).monotone (Fin.le_last i)).trans_eq
      (regularDyadic_last_time T n)
  have hProduct : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ j : J,
      Integrable (fun s => (η j).process s ω * (ξ j).process s ω) (TimeMeasure.upTo T) :=
    ae_all_iff.2 fun j => ((η j).memLp.integrable_mul (ξ j).memLp).prod_right_ae
  have hPrefix (m : ℕ) (k : Fin (2 ^ m + 1)) :
      TendstoInMeasure μ (P m k) atTop (fun ω => prefixIntegral (b ω) T (t m k)) := by
    apply TendstoInMeasure.congr_right ?_
      (tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_prefix_mul_increments_of_ito_rows
        hB hT hUsual η ξ A C hAmeas hCmeas hA hC m k)
    filter_upwards [hProduct] with ω hω
    have hRestrict (j : J) : Integrable (fun s => (η j).process s ω * (ξ j).process s ω)
        ((TimeMeasure.upTo T).restrict (Iio (t m k))) := (hω j).integrableOn
    rw [prefixIntegral_eq_setIntegral, min_eq_left (ht m k)]
    change (∑ j : J, ∫ s in Iic (t m k),
      (η j).process s ω * (ξ j).process s ω ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)) =
      ∫ s in Iio (t m k), ∑ j : J, (η j).process s ω * (ξ j).process s ω ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hRestrict j)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => setIntegral_congr_set (Iio_ae_eq_Iic' (by simp)).symm
  have hQX : TendstoInMeasure μ (Q X) atTop (E η) :=
    tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_prefix_sq_increments_of_ito_row hB hT hUsual η A hAmeas hA 0 (Fin.last _)
  have hQY : TendstoInMeasure μ (Q Y) atTop (E ξ) :=
    tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_prefix_sq_increments_of_ito_row hB hT hUsual ξ C hCmeas hC 0 (Fin.last _)
  have hI (r : J → ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T) (s : ℝ≥0) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => ∑ j : J,
        itoIntegralProcess (r j) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian j) hUsual s ω) μ :=
    (Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
      (((itoIntegralProcess_stronglyAdapted (r j) hT
        ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian j) hUsual) s).mono
          (filtration.le s)).aestronglyMeasurable).congr
      (Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simp only [Finset.sum_apply])
  have hSm (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (S n) μ := by
    have hXm (s : ℝ≥0) (hs : s ≤ T) : AEStronglyMeasurable (X s) μ :=
      (hAmeas s hs).add (hI η s)
    have hYm (s : ℝ≥0) (hs : s ≤ T) : AEStronglyMeasurable (Y s) μ :=
      (hCmeas s hs).add (hI ξ s)
    have hCell (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
        AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => W (t n i.castSucc) ω * z ω n i) μ :=
      (hWmeas _ (ht n i.castSucc)).mul
        (((hXm _ (ht n i.succ)).sub (hXm _ (ht n i.castSucc))).mul
          ((hYm _ (ht n i.succ)).sub (hYm _ (ht n i.castSucc))))
    exact (Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hCell i).congr
      (Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simp only [S, Finset.sum_apply])
  let K := (Σ m : ℕ, Fin (2 ^ m + 1)) ⊕ Bool
  let F : K → ℕ → Ω → ℝ :=
    Sum.elim (fun k => P k.1 k.2) (fun side => if side then Q Y else Q X)
  let G : K → Ω → ℝ :=
    Sum.elim (fun k ω => prefixIntegral (b ω) T (t k.1 k.2))
      (fun side => if side then E ξ else E η)
  have hF : ∀ k, TendstoInMeasure μ (F k) atTop (G k) := by
    rintro (k | side)
    · exact hPrefix k.1 k.2
    · cases side
      · exact hQX
      · exact hQY
  change TendstoInMeasure μ S atTop (fun ω => ∫ s, W s ω * b ω s ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T))
  refine (exists_seq_tendstoInMeasure_atTop_iff hSm).2 ?_
  intro u hu
  have hFamily (k : K) : TendstoInMeasure μ (F k ∘ u) atTop (G k) :=
    (hF k).comp hu.tendsto_atTop
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hPath⟩ := exists_seq_tendsto_ae_of_countable hFamily
  refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hPath, hProduct, hW] with ω hω hp hw
  let σ := u ∘ v
  have hσ : Tendsto σ atTop atTop := (hu.comp hv).tendsto_atTop
  have hEnergy : Tendsto (fun n => (Q X (σ n) ω + Q Y (σ n) ω) / 2) atTop
      (𝓝 ((E η ω + E ξ ω) / 2)) :=
    ((hω (.inr false)).add (hω (.inr true))).div_const 2
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hEnergy.bddAbove_range
  have hVar (n : ℕ) : ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), |z ω (σ n) i| ≤ M := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), (Δ X (σ n) i ω ^ 2 + Δ Y (σ n) i ω ^ 2) / 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        dsimp only [z]
        rw [abs_mul]
        have h := sq_nonneg (|Δ X (σ n) i ω| - |Δ Y (σ n) i ω|)
        nlinarith only [h, sq_abs (Δ X (σ n) i ω), sq_abs (Δ Y (σ n) i ω)]
      _ = (Q X (σ n) ω + Q Y (σ n) ω) / 2 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp only [Q, show t 0 (Fin.last (2 ^ (0 : ℕ))) = T from regularDyadic_last_time T 0,
          if_pos (ht _ _)]
      _ ≤ M := hM (mem_range_self n)
  have hb : Integrable (b ω) (TimeMeasure.upTo T) := integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hp j)
  exact tendsto_dyadic_weighted_sums_of_prefix_limits hT (fun s => W s ω) (b ω) hw hb
    (z ω) σ hσ ⟨M, hVar⟩ (fun m k => hω (.inl ⟨m, k⟩))

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoDyadicWeightedCovariation

steps.title: Control the signed cell masses
steps.text: The absolute product of the two increments is bounded by half their squared sum. The two terminal limits bound this sum along the selected subsequence. The coefficient products have integrable time sections by product L² and Fubini.
steps.lean:
have hEnergy : Tendsto (fun n => (Q X (σ n) ω + Q Y (σ n) ω) / 2) atTop
      (𝓝 ((E η ω + E ξ ω) / 2)) :=
    ((hω (.inr false)).add (hω (.inr true))).div_const 2
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hEnergy.bddAbove_range
  have hVar (n : ℕ) : ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), |z ω (σ n) i| ≤ M := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), (Δ X (σ n) i ω ^ 2 + Δ Y (σ n) i ω ^ 2) / 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        dsimp only [z]
        rw [abs_mul]
        have h := sq_nonneg (|Δ X (σ n) i ω| - |Δ Y (σ n) i ω|)
        nlinarith only [h, sq_abs (Δ X (σ n) i ω), sq_abs (Δ Y (σ n) i ω)]
      _ = (Q X (σ n) ω + Q Y (σ n) ω) / 2 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp only [Q, show t 0 (Fin.last (2 ^ (0 : ℕ))) = T from regularDyadic_last_time T 0,
          if_pos (ht _ _)]
      _ ≤ M := hM (mem_range_self n)
  have hb : Integrable (b ω) (TimeMeasure.upTo T) := integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hp j)
